doctrine: Generic editor capabilities must create project profiles through a normal workflow, not by hand-coding one game forever.
Havenwild-specific defaults remain supported, but they are migration candidates for HavenwildProjectProfile.
A project profile is reproducible from wizard choices, source-library imports, semantic asset promotion, and validation/certification outputs.
Existing Havenwild behavior is preserved while generic contracts are introduced beside it.
profileOutputs: workspace list and default dock layout
asset source mounts and import recipes
project vocabulary: zones, object categories, scene kinds, biomes, layers
hardRules: The generic workflow can generate a profile equivalent to the initial HavenwildProjectProfile seed.
Generated profile content may reference source libraries and registries, but must not silently invent missing runtime assets.
Project-specific vocabulary is data supplied by the profile, not a reason to fork the editor shell.
Compile/build behavior remains owned by the project-local PCC until the universal Forge/Cortex path is approved.
migrationOrder: Bind existing Havenwild constants to profile inventory entries.
Expose a profile wizard/view in the editor shell.
Move one small set of values at a time behind ProjectProfile lookups.
Only rename/extract crates after behavior is proven GREEN.
